audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows contradicted the whys underneath them. Rows read Skill / Warwick / Warwick / Skill / Skill / Warwick / Warwick, while every why said 'Warwick-favoured' for stages 0-4 and 'Yasuo-favoured' for the two item stages. The packet chart matches the whys.
audit.why: Wind Wall blocks projectiles, and neither Jaws of the Beast nor Infinite Duress is one — Warwick's whole pattern goes through it, so the pre-item lane is his at 57.54% over 1161 games. The flip comes with Yasuo's first crit item.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3 and 4 to Warwick and rows 5 and 6 to Yasuo, proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings moved to 7/10, 7/10, 7/10, 4/10 and 3/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why and phases[6].why credited Warwick's Blade of the Ruined King and two-item side lane as the deciding spikes on the two rows the chart gives to Yasuo.
audit.why: Yasuo's first crit item is the earlier and larger spike, and Last Breath falls from 70s at rank 1 to 30s at rank 3, so by two items his ultimate is available for nearly every fight.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why re-keyed to the crit item out-pacing Q healing; phases[6].why re-keyed to stacked crit and the 30s rank-3 Last Breath.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup — Wind Wall not stopping Warwick — appeared once in whys[2] and nowhere in the do's, and Steel Tempest's knockup condition was never stated despite dontsFull[0] being titled 'Get knocked up by his EQ'.
audit.why: Wind Wall (W, 25/23/21/19/17s) blocks projectiles for 4 seconds; Jaws of the Beast is a lunge-and-bite and Infinite Duress is a leap-and-suppress, so neither is denied by it — waiting out the wall throws away the whole window. Steel Tempest is a flat 4s and only knocks airborne at 2 stacks of Gathering Storm, and that knockup is what cuts Warwick's channelled R. Sweeping Blade has a near-zero cooldown but cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds, so he needs minions to keep dashing.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d states Last Breath's 70s rank-1 cooldown and its airborne requirement; dosFull[1].d states Wind Wall blocking projectiles only; dontsFull[0].d states the two-stack whirlwind cutting your R; dontsFull[1].d states Sweeping Blade's same-target restriction; tradeGood re-keyed to Eternal Hunger's sub-50% healing.
